tools.name: search_resources
tools.description: Use this to find a resource id before get_quote or negotiate_price. Optional input: query, words from the name, path, or address; omit it to list what is for sale. Returns matching Sepolia resources with id, title, and URL. Does not quote, negotiate, or pay.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Use this when you already have a resource_id and need the list price, floor, volume tiers, and URL. Use negotiate_price to propose a different price. Required input: resource_id from search_resources. Returns the quote. Does not change the price or pay.

tools.name: negotiate_price
tools.description: Use this to propose a test-USDC unit price and a quantity, or to accept the tier price. Use get_quote if you only need the list price. Required input: resource_id. Optional: unit_price_usdc, quantity from 1 to 100, and session_id. Returns an accepted offer or a counteroffer with offer_id and expiry.

tools.name: prepare_checkout
tools.description: Use this after an accepted offer to review the amount and get a single-use confirmation. Use pay_and_access to spend; this tool never pays. Input: offer_id, or resource_id with optional quantity for the list price. Returns the checkout summary, confirmation, total, and expiry.

tools.name: pay_and_access
tools.description: Use this only after the person agrees to pay. It is the only tool that spends. prepare_checkout never pays, and get_receipt never charges. Input: offer_id, the confirmation from prepare_checkout, and confirm=true. Pass confirm=false to decline. Public callers get x402 payment requirements instead of

tools.name: get_receipt
tools.description: Use this to deliver an already-paid resource, or to finish a payment that is still confirming. Use get_checkout_status to read state without consuming a unit. Input: tx_hash, or offer_id, or intent_id. Returns the receipt and consumes one paid unit. It never charges.

tools.name: get_checkout_status
tools.description: Use this to read whether a checkout is pending, paid, consumed, expired, or cancelled. Use get_receipt to deliver content, and cancel_checkout to invalidate an unused confirmation. Input: confirmation or offer_id. Returns the state, amount, units remaining, and expiry. It does not pay or cancel.

tools.name: cancel_checkout
tools.description: Use this to invalidate an unused confirmation so pay_and_access cannot spend it. Use get_checkout_status to read the state first. Required input: confirmation from prepare_checkout. Returns the cancelled checkout. It cannot cancel a payment that has already settled.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_resources" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

It does not negotiate or pay." → after: "Use this to find a resource id before get_quote or negotiate_price. Optional input: query, words from the name, path, or address; omit it to list what is for sale. Returns matching Sepolia resources with id, title, and URL. Does not quote, negotiate, or pay."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
